entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. Listen, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of junk. It's not working at all and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A technical fault? It's broken! It won't sync with my phone, the heart rate is all over the place... it's completely defective. I'm not going to be your beta tester. I want a refund, not a 20-question interrogation. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak with a manager, I can definitely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order information to check on the return options. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Sterling, order number is VF8-1138. You'd better find a good option, or I'll be posting reviews about this defective product and your terrible service on every website I can find.
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I review your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Let me just check our policy here.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see you received the band about two weeks ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now because of the defective issue.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what I expected. It shouldn't have been this difficult. So what's next?

I completely agree, and I apologize for the hassle. I've just initiated the return for you. You will receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the box and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
Fine. As long as I get my money back. Thank you.
You're welcome, Mark. Your refund will be processed as soon as the warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
